subject: POC: ShopFlux trial — scope update and acceptance plan
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@shopflux.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
Cc: devops@shopflux.com
Date: Sun, 2 Nov 2025 10:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-kickoff items — add rerank use case?

Alex — thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap and one request from our side: ShopFlux would like to add a lightweight product-recommendation reranking path into the trial scope in addition to the chat/search intents we discussed. The reasoning: we expect the rerank path to be a low-latency, high-value lift for search-to-cart conversion and it exercises a slightly different token pattern.

Key asks from ShopFlux: 
- Add rerank as an explicit POC use case (sample traffic ~2k requests/day).
- Success criteria: top-10 relevance lift >= 6% over current model in our A/B; model response P95 latency <= 120ms; inference cost delta < 1.5x.
- Ownership: we can deliver anonymized event feed and sample catalog slices by next Wed.

Can Redwood confirm whether this can be accommodated mid-trial and what evaluation changes you would need? If it's doable, please update the acceptance matrix and timeline. I attached the ShopFlux data schema for reference.

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Head of Product, ShopFlux
--
ShopFlux | olivia@shopflux.com
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@shopflux.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, devops@shopflux.com
Date: Sun, 2 Nov 2025 12:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-kickoff items — add rerank use case?

Thanks Olivia — really helpful recap. Short answer: we can support adding the rerank use case mid-POC with a slight re-baseline and an abbreviated eval window. High-level proposal below; I attached an updated POC plan (redwood-poc-plan-v2.pdf) and a small scope-change patch.

Proposed changes (summary):
- Scope: add rerank path with the following acceptance gates:
  * Quality: relative top-10 click uplift >= 5% (we propose 5% as a minimum threshold given short eval window)
  * Latency: P95 <= 120ms (same as your ask)
  * Cost: inferred token cost delta <= 1.6x (to leave buffer for quantization variants)
- Eval approach: run a 7-day live A/B on a sampled 20% of traffic for rerank, plus an offline ranking evaluation on your provided catalog slices.
- Timeline: we can onboard the rerank dataset and run an initial pass in ~6 business days from receipt of samples; final acceptance in ~14 business days.

Owners & immediate next steps:
- Alex Martinez (me): overall POC lead, evaluation owner, acceptance sign-off.
- Ben Carter: infra/throughput & model variant testing (quantization, batching).
- Olivia / ShopFlux: provide anonymized event feed + catalog slice by Wed (2025-11-05).

Open questions for you:
1) Can ShopFlux approve the shortened quality threshold (5%) for the mid-POC add? We can run the full 6% bar for the final rebaseline if you prefer, but it will likely extend the evaluation window by ~1 week.
2) Any constraints on storing the catalog slice in our staging bucket (we support S3 or Google Cloud)?

I also pasted a brief acceptance matrix into the top of the attached PDF. If this looks good, I’ll circulate an updated HubSpot deal note and amend the intake document.

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@shopflux.com>

Subject: Re: Post-kickoff items — add rerank use case?

Alex — thanks, that plan looks sensible. A couple of clarifications: 
- ShopFlux can accept the 5% interim threshold for the mid-POC add, but we'd like Redwood to run a second, short verification sweep at the 6% bar before final handoff.
- We'll provide the catalog slices and an anonymized event feed by EOD Wed (2025-11-05). We prefer S3 staging (same bucket we used for the demo).
- One additional ask: can Redwood include a basic compliance checklist for any PII/data handling related to the event feed? Our security team will want that before we put data into staging.

If you can confirm the compliance checklist and final timeline, we’ll mark the HubSpot deal as 'POC scope updated'.

Thanks — Olivia

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>

Cc: Olivia Barnes <olivia@shopflux.com>, devops@shopflux.com
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-kickoff items — add rerank use case? (infra note)

Quick infra check-in and ETA:
- We can stage the catalog in ShopFlux's S3 bucket and pull into our staging cluster with read-only credentials. Ben will coordinate the connector (ETA: 48 hours after we receive credentials).
- Throughput/latency: to meet P95 <= 120ms we recommend using the 4-bit quantized variant for the rerank model with dynamic batching tuned to 8-12 requests per batch (benchmarks attached in the PDF). That keeps cost increase near the 1.5x target.
- Compliance checklist: I've attached a short (one-page) handling checklist we can include in the staging handoff (scope-change-patch.docx). It enumerates allowed fields, masking guidance, and retention window (30 days for the staging slices).

Next steps:
1) Olivia: send S3 path + read-only creds (or confirm we should pull from the bucket).
2) Alex: we'll need the official HubSpot deal note updated (DEAL-84321) and a quick Doc link for the acceptance matrix so CS can track.
3) Ben: I'll spin up the connector once creds are provided and report back with an initial throughput run.

Ben
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
